task.title: View login attempts (other users)
task.shortdesc: You can view previous login history for station user accounts that you have admin permission to view.

taskbody.prereq: You have a station connection from or a web browser to the station you want to monitor.
taskbody.context: The station User Manager View and the nav tree provide views that show a list of user account names.

step.cmd: Under the connected station, in the nav tree, select ConfigUserService to display the User Manager view with available users.
Right-click on the desired user name and choose View Login History from the drop down menu.
step.stepresult: The User Login History window displays with history information for up to 20 sessions for the selected user.
